pokedexEntries.rb: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.

pokedexEntries.ye: Sleeps 18 hours a day. If it senses danger, it will teleport itself to safety even as it sleeps.

pokedexEntries.go: It senses impending attacks and TELEPORTS away to safety before the actual attacks can strike.

pokedexEntries.si: If it decides to TELEPORT randomly, it creates the illusion that it has created copies of itself.

pokedexEntries.cr: It hypnotizes itself so that it can teleport away when it senses danger, even if it is asleep.

pokedexEntries.ru: ABRA sleeps for eighteen hours a day. However, it can sense the presence of foes even while it is sleeping. In such a situation, this POKéMON immediately teleports to safety.

pokedexEntries.sa: ABRA needs to sleep for eighteen hours a day. If it doesn’t, this POKéMON loses its ability to use telekinetic powers. If it is attacked, ABRA escapes using TELEPORT while it is still sleeping.

pokedexEntries.fr: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a variety of extrasensory powers even while asleep.

pokedexEntries.lg: Using its ability to read minds, it will sense impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.

pokedexEntries.em: A POKéMON that sleeps 18 hours a day. Observation revealed that it uses TELEPORT to change its location once every hour.

pokedexEntries.di: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. Even when awake, it teleports itself while remaining seated.

pokedexEntries.prl: Even while asleep, it maintains a telepathic radar. It teleports when it is threatened.

pokedexEntries.pt: Using its psychic power is such a strain on its brain that it needs to sleep for 18 hours a day.

pokedexEntries.hg: It senses impending attacks and teleports away to safety before the actual attacks can strike.

pokedexEntries.ss: If it decides to teleport randomly, it evokes the illusion that it has created copies of itself.

pokedexEntries.bw: Using its psychic power is such a strain on its brain that it needs to sleep for 18 hours a day.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Using its psychic power is such a strain on its brain that it needs to sleep for 18 hours a day.

pokedexEntries.x: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a variety of extrasensory powers even while asleep.

pokedexEntries.y: It senses impending attacks and teleports away to safety before the actual attacks can strike.

pokedexEntries.or: Abra sleeps for eighteen hours a day. However, it can sense the presence of foes even while it is sleeping. In such a situation, this Pokémon immediately teleports to safety.

pokedexEntries.as: Abra needs to sleep for eighteen hours a day. If it doesn’t, this Pokémon loses its ability to use telekinetic powers. If it is attacked, Abra escapes using Teleport while it is still sleeping.

pokedexEntries.su: It sleeps 18 hours a day. Even while sleeping, it will teleport itself to treetops and pick and eat berries there.

pokedexEntries.mo: It can teleport itself to safety while it’s asleep, but when it wakes, it doesn’t know where it is, so it panics.

pokedexEntries.us: It uses various psychic powers even while it’s sleeping, so you can’t tell whether or not it’s awake.

pokedexEntries.um: It can read others’ minds and will teleport away when danger approaches. You must clear your mind if you want to catch it.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: Sleeps 18 hours a day. If it senses danger, it will teleport itself to safety even as it sleeps.

pokedexEntries.sw: This Pokémon uses its psychic powers while it sleeps. The contents of Abra’s dreams affect the powers that the Pokémon wields.

pokedexEntries.sh: Abra can teleport in its sleep. Apparently the more deeply Abra sleeps, the farther its teleportations go.

pokedexEntries.bd: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. Even when awake, it teleports itself while remaining seated.

pokedexEntries.shp: Even while asleep, it maintains a telepathic radar. It teleports when it is threatened.

pokedexEntries.la: Spends 18 hours of the day sleeping. Even while asleep, Abra can control its psychic powers—should danger approach, the Pokémon will simply teleport away.
